newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Eletrobras says $400 mln bond due in July.
newsitem.headline: Eletrobras says $400 mln bond due in July.

text.p: Brazilian federal power holding Eletrobras plans to launch up to $400 million in dollar-denominated bonds in July's first half to finance the expansion of transmission lines, the firm's president said.
"It will happen in the first 15 days of July," Eletrobras President Firmino Ferreira Sampaio told reporters.
"We have been authorized for $200 million and hope to get approval for a total of $400 million," he said.
Sampaio said Eletrobras considered bids from 35 foreign and national bnanks but a lead manager had not been picked yet.
There was talk in the market that a $400 million 10-year bond could come as early as this week and that a lead manager had been selected.
Sampaio, speaking at Sao Paulo's industry federation Fiesp, said the funds raised from the bond would be used to accelerate priority investments in transmission.
